blocks.text: West Central homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

West Central, September 2026. Detached houses: 66 listed at month end and 2 sold in September, a sales ratio of 3% (a buyers’ market). Condos and townhomes: 78 listed at month end and 10 sold in September, a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 16 sold over 4 months against an average of 63.0 listed, about 15.8 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 8 sold. Condos and townhomes: 45 sold over 4 months against an average of 83.0 listed, about 7.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 20 sold.

faq.q: What plans shape West Central's future?
faq.a: The adopted Lougheed Transit Corridor Area Plan directs growth around future Bus Rapid Transit stations along Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road, the Town Centre Area Plan covers the downtown core at the east edge, and TransLink's Langley–Haney Place BRT is in detailed planning.

faq.a: Yes. Jared Gibbons, REALTOR® with Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, books private showings across the Fraser Valley and Metro Vancouver. Call or text 604-928-1361, or use the contact form on this site.

faq.q: How do I find out what my home in West Central is worth?
faq.a: Jared prepares a home evaluation from recent comparable sales and the condition of your home. Contact him on 604-928-1361 or through the form on this site to arrange one.
